# Cyoda AI Studio - Complete Documentation Reference

> **Note:** This file provides pointers to complete documentation rather than duplicating content.
> For full concatenated docs, AI agents should read the files listed below in sequence.

---

## Documentation Reading Order

### 1. Essential Project Documentation

Read these files in order for complete project understanding:

1. **CLAUDE.md** (1862 lines)
   - Project brain
   - Tech stack & philosophy
   - Command reference
   - Common patterns
   - Decision log
   - Troubleshooting

2. **.claude/instructions.md** (253 lines)
   - Detailed coding guidelines
   - Google ADK reference
   - Cyoda integration patterns
   - Code organization principles
   - Error handling guidelines

3. **llm_code_guidelines.md** (location varies)
   - Function size limits (50 lines max)
   - File size limits (350 lines max)
   - Naming conventions
   - Type hint requirements
   - Code organization principles

4. **README.md** (634 lines)
   - Installation guide
   - Configuration
   - API integration guidelines
   - Project structure
   - Contributing guide
   - Utility scripts

### 2. Skills Documentation (Specialized Workflows)

Located in `.claude/skills/`, read based on task:

1. **.claude/skills/add-agent/SKILL.md** (400+ lines)
   - Creating new ADK agents
   - Agent structure & configuration
   - Prompt templates
   - Tool registration
   - Evaluation tests

2. **.claude/skills/cyoda-integration/SKILL.md** (650+ lines)
   - Entity CRUD operations
   - Search patterns (simple & complex)
   - Workflow export/import
   - Authentication & token management
   - Error handling patterns

3. **.claude/skills/debug-streaming/SKILL.md** (450+ lines)
   - SSE streaming architecture
   - Field name issues (chunk vs content)
   - Connection timeout handling
   - Event handling patterns
   - Debugging techniques

4. **.claude/skills/run-evals/SKILL.md** (500+ lines)
   - Running ADK evaluations
   - Creating evaluation tests
   - Report generation
   - CI/CD integration
   - Performance benchmarking

5. **.claude/skills/workflow-management/SKILL.md** (600+ lines)
   - FSM workflow structure
   - Workflow JSON schema
   - Processor implementation
   - Criterion functions
   - Export/import operations

### 3. Cyoda Platform Documentation

Located in `llm_docs/outputs/`:

1. **llm_docs/outputs/cyoda-api-sitemap-llms.txt** (extensive)
   - All 79 Cyoda API endpoints
   - Organized by category:
     - Entity Management (15 endpoints)
     - Search APIs (8 endpoints)
     - Workflow Management (12 endpoints)
     - OAuth/Authentication (6 endpoints)
     - Model Management (10 endpoints)
     - Edge Messages (8 endpoints)
     - And more...
   - Navigation links to full documentation

2. **llm_docs/outputs/cyoda-api-descriptions-llms.txt** (medium)
   - Detailed descriptions of 13 API sections
   - Authentication flows
   - Usage guidelines
   - Best practices

3. **llm_docs/outputs/cyoda-docs-llms.txt** (extensive)
   - Platform architecture (EDBMS)
   - Event-driven patterns
   - CPL (Cyoda Processing Language)
   - Schema references
   - 105+ documentation pages
   - Conceptual guides

### 4. Contributing & Testing

1. **CONTRIBUTING.md** (location varies)
   - Development workflow

   - PR guidelines

2. **AI_TESTING_GUIDE.md** (location varies)

3. **tests/unit/README.md** (if exists)
   - Unit testing guidelines

4. **tests/integration/agents/README.md** (if exists)
   - Integration testing
   - End-to-end workflows
   - Evaluation guides

### 5. Build & Configuration

1. **Makefile** (152 lines)
   - All build commands
   - Test automation
   - Report generation
   - Code quality checks

2. **pyproject.toml** (304 lines)
   - Project metadata
   - Dependencies (runtime & dev)
   - Tool configurations:
     - Black (formatter)
     - isort (import sorting)
     - mypy (type checking)
     - pytest (testing)
     - flake8 (linting)
     - bandit (security)
     - coverage (test coverage)

3. **.env.template** (small)
   - Required environment variables
   - Configuration examples

## Detailed Component Documentation

### Application Structure

```
application/
├── agents/                     # ADK agent implementations
│   ├── coordinator/           # Main orchestrator agent
│   │   └── agent.py          # Coordinator definition
│   ├── cyoda_assistant/       # Cyoda platform integration agent
│   │   └── agent.py          # Cyoda assistant definition
│   ├── github/                # GitHub integration agent
│   ├── qa/                    # QA agent
│   ├── shared/
│   │   └── prompts/          # Prompt templates (YAML/TXT)
│   └── tests/evals/          # ADK evaluation tests
├── entity/                    # Entity definitions
│   ├── conversation/          # Conversation entity
│   ├── task/                  # Task entity
│   └── build_progress/        # Build progress tracking
├── routes/                    # Quart API endpoints
│   ├── chat.py               # Chat endpoints
│   ├── agent_routes.py       # Agent management
│   └── repository_routes.py  # Repository operations
└── services/                  # Business services
    ├── streaming_service.py  # SSE streaming
    ├── google_adk_service.py # ADK integration
    └── github_service_factory.py # GitHub service
```

### Common Structure

```
common/
├── proto/                     # gRPC protocol definitions
│   ├── cloudevents_pb2.py    # CloudEvents proto
│   └── cyoda_cloud_api_pb2.py # Cyoda API proto
├── repository/                # Data access layer
│   ├── cyoda/
│   │   └── cyoda_repository.py # Cyoda REST/gRPC client
│   └── crud_repository.py    # Generic repository interface
├── service/                   # Entity service layer
│   ├── entity_service_interface.py # Service interface
│   └── service.py            # Service implementation
├── config/                    # Configuration
│   └── config.py             # Environment & constants
├── exception/                 # Exception definitions
│   └── exception.py          # Custom exceptions
└── grpc_client/              # gRPC client utilities
    └── grpc_client.py        # gRPC connection management
```

## Comprehensive Topic Index

### Authentication & Security
- Token management: `.claude/skills/cyoda-integration/SKILL.md` (Section 4)
- OAuth flows: `llm_docs/outputs/cyoda-api-descriptions-llms.txt` (OAuth section)
- Error handling: `.claude/instructions.md` (Section 5, Error Handling)

### Agents & ADK
- Creating agents: `.claude/skills/add-agent/SKILL.md`
- Agent patterns: `.claude/instructions.md` (Section 2, ADK Reference)
- Multi-agent coordination: `application/agents/coordinator/` (code)
- Evaluation: `.claude/skills/run-evals/SKILL.md`

### Entity Management
- CRUD operations: `.claude/skills/cyoda-integration/SKILL.md` (Section 1)
- Search patterns: `.claude/skills/cyoda-integration/SKILL.md` (Section 2)
- Entity models: `application/entity/` (code examples)
- API reference: `llm_docs/outputs/cyoda-api-sitemap-llms.txt`

### Workflows
- FSM structure: `.claude/skills/workflow-management/SKILL.md` (Section 2)
- Processors: `.claude/skills/workflow-management/SKILL.md` (Section 3)
- Criterions: `.claude/skills/workflow-management/SKILL.md` (Section 2.3)
- Export/Import: `.claude/skills/workflow-management/SKILL.md` (Section 4)

### Streaming
- SSE architecture: `.claude/skills/debug-streaming/SKILL.md` (Section 2)
- Field names: `.claude/skills/debug-streaming/SKILL.md` (Issue 1)
- Event handling: `.claude/skills/debug-streaming/SKILL.md` (Section 2.2)
- Debugging: `.claude/skills/debug-streaming/SKILL.md` (Section 3)

### Code Quality
- Function size: `llm_code_guidelines.md` + `CLAUDE.md` (50 lines max)
- Type hints: `.claude/instructions.md` (Section 1)
- Testing: `.claude/skills/run-evals/SKILL.md`
- Linting: `Makefile` (lint target) + `pyproject.toml` (tool config)

### Development Workflow
- Setup: `README.md` (Development Installation Guide)
- Testing: `make test-coverage` + `make test-eval`
- Code review: `.claude/instructions.md` (Section 3, Checklist)
- Contributing: `CONTRIBUTING.md`

## How to Use This File

**For AI Agents:**

1. **Start with essentials:**
   - Read `CLAUDE.md`
   - Read `.claude/instructions.md`
   - Read `llms.txt` (documentation map)

2. **Task-specific:**
   - Read relevant skill from `.claude/skills/`
   - Consult `llm_docs/outputs/` for Cyoda specifics

3. **Deep dive:**
   - Read full files listed in "Documentation Reading Order"
   - Follow code in `application/` and `common/`

**For Humans:**

1. Start with `README.md`
2. Read `CLAUDE.md` for project overview
3. Explore `.claude/skills/` for workflows
4. Consult `llm_docs/` for Cyoda platform details
